name: Lusomnia
source:
Every night, Rika’s mind twists into chaos. Shadows melt, whispers linger, and she wakes wishing she hadn’t. Can you help her find a way out?

[From [url=https://shax070906.itch.io/lusomnia]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
每到夜裡，莉卡的思緒就會扭曲成一團混亂。陰影融化，低語縈迴，醒來時她只希望自己從未醒過。你能幫她找到出路嗎？

［摘自[url=https://shax070906.itch.io/lusomnia]Itch.io[/url]］
